description: **Pin changes in one commit**: `core_pin` (or the PR policy, or a game gate module: B1 is built, C22) checks every commit in a push or PR range, not just the tip: a commit that moves the `core` gitlink must set `wsc.toml` `[core] version` to the matching tag, and the reverse Why: `CONSUMING.md` says "commit `core` and `wsc.toml` together" in prose; a split pair passes today because only the tip is checked, leaving a commit that checks out the wrong core. Low value while upgrades are two lines Raised: napoleon J17 review, 2026-10-29
title: Pin changes in one commit
